candidates.summary: - India’s greenhouse gas emissions broke from a longer period of rapid growth in 2025, according to UNEP’s Emissions Gap Report 2026. However, different datasets disagree on whether emissions increased or declined slightly. - Renewable electricity generation increased by 98 terawatt-hours in 2025, nearly twice the increase in electricity demand, while coal-fired generation declined by 44 terawatt-hours. - Milder weather and slower electricity demand growth also contributed to the slowdown. Researchers caution that sustained emissions reductions will require greater investment in energy storage, transmission and industrial decarbonisation.
